tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh original drawing based on the sole attached adopted Blue Tree Monitor character identity/style reference, not a pixel edit. Preserve the exact blue/dark-slate skin patches, warm brown outlines, cream muzzle and belly ONLY, plain brown pupils inside white eyes without sparkle highlights, two short arms and two planted feet with the same simple brown toe lines, one curved tail on viewer right. It is the same lightly anthropomorphic upright character, no clothing or props. CRITICAL: both forepaws/hands/fingers are BLUE WITH EXISTING BLUE/DARK PATCHES everywhere, including the inner palm, fingertips and any turned surface. NO white/cream/tan palms, finger pads, claws or new undersurface markings; source hands are blue. Keep original head/neck/shoulder/abdomen and planted-foot proportions, no short torso. Genuine transparent RGBA background; full figure and appendages comfortably inside each cell. Clean original warm contour and intentional soft painted paper texture, no bleeding, mud, red fringe, shadows, ground, text, extra parts or marks. Create a square3072x3072 conceptual2x2 sheet, no visible grid, exactly four complete figures at one identical anatomical head/torso scale, no individual fit: top-left greet with one original BLUE forepaw raised in a friendly wave; top-right present_left with a BLUE forearm extending to VIEWER LEFT and eyes attending left; bottom-left present_right with a BLUE forearm extending to VIEWER RIGHT and eyes attending right, never mirror original tail/patches; bottom-right think with one BLUE forepaw gently near the cream cheek, do not turn the paw itself cream. Do not add lips, teeth, human fingers, eye highlights or any extra object. All four retain long-enough canonical torso, not squat redesigns.
